# Michelle Creamer — Realtor®, ARC Realty

> Real estate agent specializing in Liberty Park and Vestavia Hills, Alabama,
> in the greater Birmingham market. Associate Broker with ARC Realty.
> Alabama license #70777. Working in this market since 2002.

## Who she is

Michelle Creamer is a Realtor® and Associate Broker with ARC Realty, based in
Vestavia Hills, Alabama. Her focus is Liberty Park — a master-planned community
about 20 minutes east of downtown Birmingham — along with the wider Vestavia
Hills and Birmingham metro market. She has lived in Liberty Park for roughly two
decades and has worked this market since 2002.

## What she does

- Represents buyers purchasing homes in Liberty Park, Vestavia Hills and greater Birmingham
- Represents sellers listing homes in the same market
- Provides home valuations and pricing guidance for sellers
- Advises relocating buyers moving into the Birmingham metro
- Handles luxury property, new construction, acreage and lots, and commercial listings

## Areas served

Liberty Park, Vestavia Hills, Mountain Brook, Hoover, Homewood, and the greater
Birmingham metropolitan area, Alabama. Specific Liberty Park neighborhoods
include The Bray, Vestlake Village and Old Overton.

## Listing data

Listings on michellesellslibertypark.com come from the Internet Data Exchange
(IDX) program of Greater Alabama MLS. Listings held by brokerage firms other
than ARC Realty are shown with the name of the listing broker. Listing
information is deemed reliable but not guaranteed.
